bull.b: The large recurring component tied to procedures, instruments, accessories, and service gives Intuitive Surgical greater revenue visibility than a purely transactional model. As the installed base and procedure volumes expand, this structure can support durable cash generation and customer retention.

Strong procedure growth alongside a growing installed base reinforces Intuitive Surgical’s network effect: more systems create capacity for future procedures, while higher utilization supports recurring instrument and service demand. This expands the company’s long-term presence across hospitals and specialties.

High gross and operating margins, substantial free cash flow, and minimal leverage provide financial resilience and flexibility. This strength allows Intuitive Surgical to continue funding research, product development, training, and international expansion without depending heavily on borrowing.

bear.b: Although revenue and procedures are still growing, a slower growth profile reduces the pace at which the installed base, recurring revenue, and earnings can compound. Sustaining premium profitability may become more dependent on new indications, product adoption, and deeper utilization.

China’s weaker tender activity and stronger domestic competition can constrain system placements and pressure pricing in an important international market. The absence of da Vinci 5 clearance in Mainland China also limits the company’s ability to use its newest platform there.

Extended-use instruments could lower customer cost per procedure and reduce recurring instrument revenue, while procedure-mix shifts toward lower-value cases may add pressure. Because the program’s effect is unquantified, its potential impact on revenue quality and margins remains uncertain.
